description: This Java interface defines a contract for a MongoDB index key, specifying methods to retrieve the field name and associated BSON value.

classes.name: IndexKey
classes.description: Interface for a MongoDB index key, providing methods to access the field name and BSON value.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field for the index key.

methods.name: getBsonValue
methods.description: Returns the BSON value defining the type of the key.
